apps.name: Sudofall
apps.description: A mix between Tetris and Sudoku — drop numbers into the grid, clear rows and 3x3 boxes to score points.

apps.name: FindYourself
apps.description: Drop into a random Street View location anywhere in the world and guess where you are on the map. Requires a Google Maps API key.

apps.name: Game Hub
